feature_name: Hardened Fixed Point and Bound Element Parsing
description: Implement enhanced parsing logic for fixed points and bound elements during editor restoration to prevent data corruption and ensure consistent element positioning. This fix should address edge cases where malformed or incomplete data could lead to incorrect element restoration or application crashes.
functional_requirements: Add validation checks to ensure fixed point coordinates are valid numbers before processing during restoration
Implement graceful fallback handling for bound element references that point to non-existent or corrupted elements
Add comprehensive error boundaries around parsing logic to prevent restoration failures from crashing the entire application
